evidence: On Banking77 test rows 200:296 (n=96) the frozen-encoder candidate-set scorer reached accuracy 0.531. Learned K=8 then packed rerank reached 0.688 on the same rows.
revisit_only_if: The K=8 reranker ceiling is shown to be stuck while retrieval recall is already high.
A product requirement appears for candidate counts where packing eight rerank labels is not enough.
A candidate-interaction training run beats K=8 end-to-end on a split that did not choose K.
